name: (Coral Dragon) Palytoxin
text:
Any creature who takes damage from the dragon's jaws, claws, or tail attack, or who Strikes and does damage to the dragon with an unarmed attack, takes 1d6 poison damage (2d6 poison for ancient and archdragons) and must attempt a Fortitude save saving throw (DC equal to the DC of the dragon's Hydraulic Breath).

---
Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's enfeebled condition increases by 1 until the end of its next turn, to a maximum of 3. If the creature is already Enfeebled 3, it becomes Drained 1 instead.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature's enfeebled condition increases by 2 instead of 1.
